Text: God, through the humility of Your Son, You elevated all of creation. [t] Lavish holy joy upon Your faithful. [*] For You freed our lives from the slavery of sin. Let us rejoice with a joy that has no end, through Jesus Christ.
Changes: 2024-07-07 - Paul Prins: Revised to fit current concluding prayer style
